name: Astera Labs
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $186.06 (-16.7%) after $223.27 (-4.4%) Nov 4. No company news; sold with AI chips on midterm data-centre fears. Q3 (Nov 3) revenue $584.9M (+154% y/y), Q4 guide $730-750M. Now about 51% below the Oct 7 close of $382.25.
risks: Beta near 3.8; two-day fall of about 20% after a beat-and-raise shows sentiment is driving price. Fewer data-centre starts would cut connectivity demand.
catalyst: NVDA results Nov 17; Aries 7 sampling in Q4.

name: Advanced Micro Devices
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $413.06 (-15.5%) after $488.78 (+1.0%) Nov 4. Among the worst S&P decliners as AI chips sold off on the Democratic sweep. Q3 revenue $13.4B, data centre $8.5B (+97%); Q4 guide about $17B.
risks: MI450/Helios ramp is early and needs new data-centre capacity; policy-driven build pauses hit it first.
catalyst: NVDA Nov 17 as read-across; Helios ramp in Q4.

name: ASML
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $1,383.22 (-7.6%) after $1,496.30 (-3.6%) Nov 4. EUV monopoly; fell with chips on data-centre fears.
risks: China export rules; fewer fab starts if AI capex slows.
catalyst: Applied Materials results Nov 12; Q4 results January.

name: Broadcom
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $297.31 (-8.7%) after $325.48 (-2.0%) Nov 4; held up better than AMD and ALAB. Custom accelerators for Google, Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic plus Ethernet; $63B Anthropic lease vehicle delivers from 2027.
risks: 2027-28 site build-outs could slow under state-level data-centre limits; lease-vehicle residual-value exposure.
catalyst: Q4 FY26 results around Dec 10 (not confirmed); NVDA Nov 17.

name: Celestica
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $206.01 (-12.9%) after $236.41 (-9.1%) Nov 4; about 31% below the Oct 28 close of $299.80. No company news. 2027 outlook $40B revenue and $21.50 EPS puts it near 9.6x 2027 EPS.
risks: Few hyperscaler customers; Texas holds roughly a quarter of planned US data-centre GW and the incoming governor wants a moratorium.
catalyst: Buyback (up to 2.5% of float) filing in Q4; Q4 results late January.

name: SK hynix
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $126.18 (-11.8%) after $143.07 (-5.1%) Nov 4. Kospi fell 5.3%. Q3 operating profit about KRW 83.3T; HBM4 in mass production. Qualcomm blamed its miss on higher memory costs, which shows pricing power.
risks: DRAM spot slipping (DDR5 16Gb -1.09% Nov 5); crowded trade near a cycle peak.
catalyst: TrendForce October contract prices; NVDA Nov 17.

name: Vertiv
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $175.05 (-14.8%) after $205.55 (-12.9%) Nov 4; about 26% down in two sessions. No company news; pure data-centre policy selling.
risks: Almost all growth tied to data-centre builds; Texas moratorium push.
catalyst: 2027 guide with Q4 results in February; any Texas legislative move.

name: Bloom Energy
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $166.72 (-16.8%) after $200.40 (-6.4%) Nov 4; the Nov 3 Barclays-upgrade gain is gone. Q3 revenue $1.236B (+138%); 2026 guide $4.4-4.6B.
risks: Behind-the-meter gas power for data centres is a likely policy target; capex turned Q3 cash flow negative.
catalyst: Oracle Jupiter permit Nov 23; 2027 guide with Q4 results in February.

name: GE Vernova
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $772.05 (-7.3%) after $832.83 (-9.3%) Nov 4. Only about 20% of contracted gas-turbine capacity serves data centres; backlog about $197-200B; buyback $20B.
risks: Policy risk on data-centre power; Trench deal financing; momentum selling.
catalyst: Trench close; Q4 orders and gas slot conversion.

name: Robinhood Markets
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $77.15 (-11.7%) after $87.41 (+2.0%) Nov 4. No company news found; fell with high-beta growth as the S&P dropped about 3.5%.
risks: Retail trading and crypto volumes fall in risk-off weeks.

name: MercadoLibre
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $1,509.27 (-13.3%) after Q3. Revenue $10.75B (+45%, +41% FX-neutral); operating income $676M (-6%), margin 6.3%; net income $448M (+6%), EPS $8.83. TPV $109B (+53%), GMV $23B (+38%), credit book about $18B (+62%).
risks: Margins still falling on shipping and credit build; NIMAL 20.1% (-1pt y/y); NPL 15-90 days 7.0%. No numeric guide.
catalyst: Shipping-cost relief in Q4; Q4 results February.

name: Cloudflare
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $237.60 (-10.9%) ahead of Q3 results after the close today. Q3 guide (Aug 6) $736-737M revenue and $0.34 non-GAAP EPS; FY guide $2.864-2.870B. Results not yet out at time of writing.
risks: Results land in a risk-off tape; high multiple.
catalyst: Q3 beat: revenue +39% to $782.5M; Q4 guide $845-846M; up 14.7% after hours on Nov 5 after -8.3% in the session.

name: Sea Limited
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $75.06 (-6.4%) after $80.19 (+4.5%) Nov 4. Shopee, Garena and Monee; less AI-exposed than most of the list.
risks: Shopee investment spend; MELI's margin squeeze shows e-commerce competition cost.
catalyst: Q3 results Tue Nov 10 before US open, call 7:30am ET (23:30 AEDT Tue Nov 10).

name: Keyence
thesis: Factory automation sensors and vision, about 50% operating margin, net cash. Nikkei fell 1.8% Nov 5 vs Kospi -5.3%; Keyence is not a data-centre name. No fresh dated quote found.

name: Teradyne
thesis: Nov 5 about 1:36pm ET (intraday, not final): $219.76 (-12.4%) after $250.99 (-6.8%) Nov 4. AI accelerator and HBM test demand.
risks: Test demand follows accelerator volumes; robotics still weak.
catalyst: NVDA Nov 17; AMAT Nov 12 as equipment read.
